fact: On 14 April 2026 the education minister opened the data centre at the ministry's Information and Documentation Centre, where the centre's engineers explained its operation and presented the education data management system, the Tayseer data system and the Kawader HR system.
title: الوزير يفتتح مركز البيانات ويُطلق المواقع الإلكترونية للوزارة والجهات التابعة
